motor.note: Null response times inherit the original 0.05 s estimate. Steady thrust stays linear until a measured curve is imported. Normalized rotor speed is inferred from sqrt(thrust); it is not a measured RPM model.

aerodynamics.note: Unmeasured estimate: CdA = 0.75 times each projected propeller-free envelope area. Rotor drag and angular damping inherit the shared provisional model; not fitted to DJI performance.

ground_effect.note: Bounded flat-ground image-rotor approximation using each rotor's height. Fades out with tilt. Applies to thrust only; this is not a propwash or vortex-ring model.

contact.note: Four approximate support points below the frame. Inelastic impulses and Coulomb friction; no frame flex or damage model. Rotor disk contact counts as a crash.
